purpose: Raise useful output per launched /wc by measuring every durable launch, balancing strategy samples after ownership, filtering capability-bound work before authority, biasing comparable work toward product value, and carrying bounded context/successor state forward without changing claim authority.
truth_boundaries: Derived launch measurements are observability only; durable PIN/claim remains authority.
A synthesized launch row never invents strategy enrollment, visible change, successor creation, Human Acceptance, Served state or causal evidence.
Product-value bias applies only between already-authorized, grounded, comparably useful actions and never overrides safety, authority, capability or definition-of-done.
Context capsules and successor relays reduce archaeology; they do not widen authority.
A launch row begins from a fresh current-turn beacon; historical terminal evidence cannot substitute for a new human launch.

automatic_launch_measurement.source: durable beacon + PIN/claim + no-allocation + RETURN/Guide receipt + explicit exam when present

strategy_balance.primary_rule: For the enrolled job_class, choose the variant with fewer independent workers carrying >=1 experimental slot in the fresh scoreboard.

capability_specialization.rule: Definitively absent capabilities are filtered before authority; specialized work remains visible to compatible runtimes; unknown capability is not absence.
capability_specialization.negative_cache_scope: capability class / runtime contract, never target-specific secret or private inference
capability_specialization.circuit_breaker_rule: Repeated proven capability mismatch must suppress equivalent generic routing until a compatible runtime exists; explicit transport/safety denials are telemetry, not bypass targets.

value_budget.rule: When CONTROL_OVERHEAD exceeds the soft budget outside critical rescue, prefer an already-grounded compatible PRODUCT_VALUE candidate over optional additional control-plane work.

context_capsule.bounded_reads: Load the exact postclaim source named by the allocator; broad project archaeology is forbidden unless that source proves SOURCE_DEBT.
context_capsule.persist_when: Persist the capsule only when handing unfinished grounded work to a successor or when a durable return requires it.

successor_relay.required_when: A worker stops with a concrete unfinished residual that is safe, non-duplicate and grounded enough to execute.

compounding_gates.acceleration_rule: Do not call growth compounding unless useful output per launch and product-value conversion improve across >=3 comparable windows without rising coordination/control overhead.

postclaim_return_transport_continuation.purpose: Do not retire a resident production chat solely because the connector refuses the canonical postclaim RETURN write after real work and verification are already durable.
applies_when: launch is not RUN packet mode
E5 production and E6 evidence-map verification are complete
connector/tool explicitly denies canonical RETURN or Guide receipt persistence and therefore proves it was not written
one separately permitted transport-boundary receipt is durable with exact authority/start/completed evidence refs
behavior: do not retry or bypass the denied operation/path
do not increment productive_units for the blocked unit
do not release or mutate the prior authority target
refresh the compact frontier and enter E8 only for unrelated compatible work
leave the blocked job to normal stale/recovery rules
if the boundary receipt itself cannot be persisted, stop safely instead of continuing
postclaim_return_transport_continuation.safety_boundary: This is capacity continuation, not evidence substitution. A transport-boundary receipt never becomes a RETURN and never makes the blocked unit PASS.
